str_exit.label: Short-term rental exit
str_exit.short_description: STR license removed in the last year
str_exit.description: Short-term rental license removed in the last year.
str_exit.rationale: A short-term rental license for this property was removed in the last year, so the home may no longer earn that rental income and its future use is worth asking about.

tired_landlord.label: Tired landlord
tired_landlord.short_description: Long-held absentee owner with a distress signal
tired_landlord.description: Long-held absentee owner with a distress or friction signal.
tired_landlord.rationale: The owner does not live at the property, has held it 15 or more years, and there is a sign of friction on it (an open code enforcement case, an expired permit or a removed rental license). Long-held rentals with friction are homes where a conversation about selling can be timely.

builder_bait.label: Builder bait
builder_bait.short_description: Estimated upzoning potential on a large lot
builder_bait.description: Estimated upzoning potential on a large lot with a long-held owner.
builder_bait.rationale: The lot is much larger than most in its area and an estimated state-law screen says it may allow splitting the lot or building more homes. The owner has held it 20 or more years, so a builder or investor may see more in the land than a typical buyer would.

pre_list_prep.label: Pre-list prep
pre_list_prep.short_description: Pre-sale permit on a long-held home
pre_list_prep.description: Pre-sale type permit approved in the last 6 months on a long-held home.
pre_list_prep.rationale: A permit for cosmetic or remodel work (kitchen, bath, windows, roof, paint, landscaping) was approved in the last six months on a home the owner has held 10 or more years. This is the kind of work that often goes in before a sale.

stalled_project.label: Stalled project
stalled_project.short_description: Permit expired with no close date
stalled_project.description: Permit expired more than 90 days ago with no close date.
stalled_project.rationale: A building permit expired more than 90 days ago and was never closed, so the project may be unfinished.

downsizer.label: Downsizer
downsizer.rationale: The owner lives in the home, has held it 20 or more years and has no open mortgage. Owners with this profile may want a smaller or simpler home.

insurance_squeeze.label: Insurance squeeze
insurance_squeeze.short_description: High or very high fire hazard zone
insurance_squeeze.description: High or very high fire hazard zone.
insurance_squeeze.rationale: The home is in a high or very high fire hazard zone, where insurance can cost more or be harder to get.

financial_pressure.label: Financial pressure
financial_pressure.short_description: Tax default, a recorder default notice, or lost rental income with a mortgage
financial_pressure.description: Tax default, a recorder notice of default, an open code enforcement case, or lost rental income with an open mortgage.

quiet_inheritance.label: Quiet inheritance
quiet_inheritance.short_description: Recent transfer by death, trust or inheritance
quiet_inheritance.description: A recorded transfer by death, trust or inheritance in the last two years.
quiet_inheritance.rationale: A recorder document shows the home changed hands by death, trust or inheritance. A new owner or trustee may be deciding what to do with the property, and a neutral conversation about its value can be timely.
